title: Look at what groupBy returns first
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: Two things to notice. It is an object, not an array. And the keys are the strings `"1"` and `"2"` even though `priority` was a number — an object key is always a name, so the grouping value is coerced on the way in.
